requirements.statement: The CI gate MUST exit 0 only for a qualified assessment with no fired reassessment trigger, 2 for a not qualified result or a required reassessment, and 1 for usage or input errors, and a relaxed fail-on mode MUST NOT change the printed summary.

tests.title: qualified and current inputs exit 0 and print a compact summary
a failed critical check exits 2 with the blocker code
missing evidence exits 2 as insufficient evidence
currency only mode exits 2 with trigger codes when the subject changed or the assessment expired
an open high severity incident makes a qualified assessment require reassessment
usage and input errors exit 1 with a message on stderr
fail-on controls the exit code without changing the summary

requirements.statement: The CI gate MUST produce byte-identical output for identical inputs when a time is supplied, and when no time is supplied it MUST read the system clock and state that in its summary.

tests.title: the same arguments with now produce byte identical output
omitting now uses the system clock and says so
system clock use in GitHub Actions raises a warning annotation

requirements.statement: The CI gate MUST escape every untrusted string it places in workflow annotations, the Markdown step summary and step outputs so that agent names, check identifiers and forged report text cannot start workflow commands, inject Markdown or HTML, or add output keys, and it MUST NOT print environment secrets.

tests.title: annotation text from untrusted names is escaped and cannot start a new command
a forged assessment with newlines in text fields cannot inject workflow commands or markdown
GITHUB_OUTPUT and GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY are appended to and carry no secrets
GitHub annotations appear only when GITHUB_ACTIONS is true

requirements.statement: The CI gate MUST write its step outputs before a failing exit, MUST treat an unwritable output path as an input error, MUST refuse unknown members in an inputs file, and SHOULD warn when the result rests on fixture evidence.

tests.title: outputs are written before a failing exit so the workflow can read them
an unwritable GITHUB_OUTPUT path is an input error
an inputs file with unknown members is refused
individual input flags give the same result as an inputs file
currency only mode exits 0 when the stored assessment is still current
fixture only evidence raises a warning even when the policy qualifies it

requirements.statement: Each policy template MUST be a valid preset that states a rationale, explicit limits and that its thresholds are not validated, and a policy generated from it MUST pass policy validation and bind the digest of the supplied profile deterministically.

tests.title: every template file is valid JSON with a rationale explicit limits and a not validated flag
each template generates a policy that passes validatePolicy and binds the real profile digest
output is deterministic and carries no clock or key material
the template documentation states these are starting points and no template makes an agent safe

requirements.statement: A policy template MUST NOT accept fixture or declaration evidence, so fixture evidence MUST NOT qualify an agent under any template, and the strict templates MUST withhold results lacking independent evidence, an accountable party or fresh evidence.

tests.title: templates are conservative and never accept fixture or declaration evidence
fixture evidence never qualifies any template even when its signer is trusted
self signed runtime evidence qualifies the read only template and nothing stricter
independent runtime evidence with a declared accountable party qualifies code agent and payments
an undeclared accountable party withholds the code agent and payments templates
stale runtime evidence is refused by the payments template within its short window
a failed non critical mandatory check blocks the payments template with a named code
a failed critical check blocks every template

requirements.statement: The policy generator MUST refuse unknown templates, malformed or private key material and missing independent keys where required, MUST NOT echo key material, and options MUST only tighten a template.

tests.title: unknown templates and path tricks are refused
trust key problems are refused without echoing key material
templates that need independent evidence are refused without an independent key
weakening a template or naming unknown checks is refused
a profile missing the template checks or an existing output file is refused
overrides can tighten a template and the flags are honoured
a profile other than the frozen core profile is refused without allow-custom-profile
allow-custom-profile generates a policy with a prominent warning and a marked id

requirements.statement: The CI gate MUST report a result as reliable only for runtime evidence unless fixture evidence is explicitly allowed, MUST name the reason code when it withholds reliability, and MUST NOT treat declaration evidence as reliable under any option.

tests.title: fixture evidence is not reliable by default and exits 2 with a named reason
allow-fixture makes qualified fixture evidence reliable and records no reason code
runtime evidence is reliable without any flag and mixed evidence is not
a declaration or unknown evidence mode is never reliable even with allow-fixture

requirements.statement: The CI gate MUST refuse with a named error, before printing any result, when a supplied policy or evaluator digest differs from an expected pinned digest.

tests.title: policy and evaluator digest pins pass on a match and refuse a mismatch before any summary
pins also apply in currency only mode and a policy edited after the pin is refused

requirements.statement: The CI gate MUST NOT cut a JSON output value mid-string; an oversized summary MUST be replaced by a compact valid object marked truncated.

tests.title: an oversized summary becomes a compact valid truncated JSON output value
